title: A local tarball shadows a published version silently
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach installs (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 9)
details: A version in a data directory takes the place of the same version from an image or from the upstream (R9, R24), which is the point. When its bytes differ from the one it replaces, nothing says so. The install then records an integrity no published copy has, and the next machine that installs from the published one fails with EINTEGRITY. It should warn, naming both integrities.
